summary: Newchip Accelerator appears inactive: the official launch/application subdomain does not resolve, the live Newchip homepage is an investor marketplace with no accelerator application or cohort information, and public bankruptcy records show Astralabs Inc. d/b/a Newchip Accelerator in Chapter 7 bankruptcy.

sources.title: ASTRALABS INC Bankruptcy Filing
sources.supports: Astralabs Inc. filed bankruptcy in the Western District of Texas on March 17, 2023; case is Chapter 7 and active.

sources.title: Case number: 1:23-bk-10164 - ASTRALABS Inc - Texas Western Bankruptcy Court
sources.supports: Court docket identifies Astralabs Inc. as d/b/a Newchip and d/b/a Newchip Accelerator, Chapter 7, converted from Chapter 11 on May 12, 2023.

sources.title: This Austin accelerator made big claims; employees and customers say it didn’t deliver
sources.supports: Reports Newchip was an online accelerator, filed for Chapter 11 in March 2023, and was converted to Chapter 7 liquidation in May 2023.

notes: No current official application deadline, cohort dates, demo day, or program cadence were found.
